repositories.name: gods-eye-view
repositories.description: A spy satellite simulator in your browser, except the data is real. Live open source spatial intelligence on a photorealistic 3D globe.
repositories.summary: 一个在浏览器中运行的开源三维地球仪，用公开数据实时追踪飞机、船舶、卫星等目标，可查看地形并支持语音交互。

repositories.name: DeskcommCRM
repositories.description: Open-source AI sales OS — self-hosted CRM with native AI agents + WhatsApp (WAHA). Open alternative to Kommo, Octadesk & Intercom for any business that sells by chat. MCP-ready, multi-tenant, LGPD.

repositories.name: system_prompts_leaks
repositories.description: Extracted system prompts from Anthropic - Claude Fable 5.1, Opus 5, Claude Design, Claude Code. OpenAI - ChatGPT GPT-6-Astra, Codex. Google - Gemini 3.8 Flash, 3.1 Pro, Antigravity. xAI - Grok, Grok Bot, Cursor, Kimi and more! Updated regularly.
repositories.summary: 收集并整理各大 AI 聊天机器人与编程助手泄露的系统提示词，按厂商分类存档，供查阅研究。

repositories.name: iloader
repositories.summary: iloader 是一款用 TypeScript 开发的用户友好侧载工具，可安装 SideStore 等应用并自动导入配对文件。

repositories.name: zapret-discord-youtube
repositories.summary: 基于 zapret 的 Windows 批处理脚本，用于绕过 DPI 封锁，恢复 Discord、YouTube 等服务的访问。

repositories.name: MathModelAgent
repositories.description: 🤖📐专为数学建模设计的 Agent & skills ,自动完成数学建模，生成一份完整的可以直接提交的论文。 An Agent Designed for Mathematical Modeling ,Automatically complete mathmodel and generate a complete paper ready for submission.
repositories.summary: MathModelAgent 是面向数学建模竞赛的自动化工具，可分析问题、编写代码并生成格式完整的可提交论文。

repositories.name: Sonarr
repositories.description: Smart PVR for newsgroup and bittorrent users.
repositories.summary: Sonarr 是一款面向 Usenet 和 BitTorrent 用户的 PVR 工具，可监控剧集更新、自动下载、整理和重命名，并在出现更高画质时自动升级。

repositories.name: CloddsBot
repositories.description: Open Source AI trading agent that operates autonomously across 1000+ markets - Polymarket, Kalshi, Binance, Hyperliquid, Solana DEXs, 5 EVM chains. Scans for edge, executes instantly, manages risk while you sleep. Agent commerce protocol for machine-to-machine payments. Self-hosted. Built on Claude.
repositories.summary: CloddsBot 是一个基于 Claude 的开源自主 AI 交易代理，可跨预测市场、加密货币和期货等平台自动扫描机会、执行交易并管理风险。

repositories.name: SmartTube
repositories.description: Browse media content with your own rules on Android TV
repositories.summary: SmartTube 是面向 Android TV 和电视盒子的开源媒体客户端，可在电视优化界面中浏览和播放各类公开来源的内容。

repositories.name: awesome-llm-apps
repositories.description: 100+ AI Agents, Agent Skills and RAG Apps - Free and Open Source.
repositories.summary: 这是一个开源项目，汇集了100多个AI智能体、智能体技能和RAG应用示例，主要用Python编写，供开发者克隆、运行和二次开发。

repositories.name: OpenFlux
repositories.description: Network stack research tool. TCP tunnel with pluggable transports.
repositories.summary: OpenFlux 是一个用 Go 编写的网络协议栈研究工具，实现带可插拔传输层的 TCP 隧道，客户端提供 SOCKS5 代理，经出口节点转发流量。

repositories.name: armorpaint
repositories.summary: ArmorPaint 是一款用于 3D PBR 纹理绘制的软件，此仓库面向开发者提供其源代码。

repositories.name: Claude-Red
repositories.description: claude-red is a curated library of offensive security skills designed for the Claude skills system. Each skill is a structured SKILL.md file that primes Claude with expert-level methodology for a specific attack surface — from SQLi to shellcode, EDR evasion to exploit development.
repositories.summary: claude-red 是面向 Claude 技能系统的攻防安全技能库，用结构化 SKILL.md 文件为各类攻击面提供专家级方法论。

repositories.name: YuE
repositories.description: YuE2: frontier music generation with symbolic planning, zero-shot covers, and agentic music editing.
repositories.summary: YuE2 是 Python 音乐生成项目，统一符号与音频生成，支持歌曲创作、零样本翻唱和智能体音乐编辑。

repositories.name: worktrunk

repositories.summary: Worktrunk 是一个用 Rust 编写的 Git worktree 管理命令行工具，主要用于并行运行多个 AI 代理工作流。

repositories.name: pentagi
repositories.description: Fully autonomous AI Agents system capable of performing complex penetration testing tasks
